Container.Name: unraid-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that provides AI assistants with tools to interact with your Unraid server via its GraphQL API. Enables system monitoring, Docker and VM management, storage management, and more through a standardized protocol. Supports streamable-http, SSE, and stdio transports.
Container.Requires: Requires a valid Unraid API key. Navigate to Settings > Management Access > API in your Unraid webGUI to generate one.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port for the MCP server. Must match the UNRAID_MCP_PORT environment variable.

Config.Name: Unraid API URL
Config.Description: Your Unraid GraphQL API endpoint URL (e.g., https://your-unraid-ip/graphql)

Config.Name: Unraid API Key
Config.Description: Your Unraid API key for authentication. Generate one from Settings > Management Access > API in the Unraid webGUI.

Config.Name: MCP Transport
Config.Description: Transport protocol for the MCP server. Options: streamable-http (recommended), sse (deprecated), stdio.

Config.Name: MCP Host
Config.Description: Host address the MCP server listens on.

Config.Name: MCP Port Variable
Config.Description: Port number the MCP server listens on internally. Must match the mapped port above.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level for the MCP server. Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

Config.Name: Verify SSL
Config.Description: Whether to verify SSL certificates when connecting to the Unraid API. Set to true if using a valid SSL certificate.

Config.Name: Enabled Modules
Config.Description: Tool preset: 'default' (~32 tools), 'extended' (~78 tools), or 'all' (~129 tools). Add individual modules with commas: 'default,plugins,auth'.

Config.Name: Log Directory
Config.Description: Path for MCP server log files.
